d: Short, messy jet black hair with choppy bangs falls over a youthful, adolescent face with bright azure, wide eyes. The build is slender and slight. The outfit consists of silver plate armor with gold accents over a blue tunic and matching blue trousers, paired with grey laced boots and a brown leather utility belt. Signature details include a silver heater shield with engraved markings and a silver longsword with a gold hilt.
